page.overview:
Who is El Chupacabra?

El Chupacabra is a minor character in Invincible. He is one of the many superheroes who participated in the Invincible War, fighting alongside others in the global effort to stop the evil Invincible variants.

El Chupacabra wears a distinctive jungle green and burnt orange costume with a fierce, primal design. The majority of the outfit is green, while burnt orange accents cover the eye mask, portions of the gloves, shoulders, and the emblem on his chest. His gloves and leggings are primarily white, providing contrast to the darker tones. His costume is adorned with numerous spikes, most notably on his mask, arms, shoulder blades, and elongated clawed gloves, enhancing his fierce, beast-like appearance.

El Chupacabra is known for his fearlessness, demonstrated when he boldly faced off against a powerful variant of Invincible during the Invincible War.

Little is known about El Chupacabra’s background, other than his real name, Francisco Vasquez, and that he was hired by the Global Defense Agency.
